Name: Shardust's Pastel Furniture for Alternative Textures
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][size=3][u][b][size=5]Shardust's Pastel Furniture for Alternative Textures[/size][/b][/u]

I needed a break from drawing hair so I made furniture with new and old colors.

Featuring 60 Retextured Furniture items (plus Wallpapers and Floors to match) somewhat divided in sets (for es. all the Mahogany-named items share the same textures to match each other) in 7 (plus white as neutral) colors in Pastel hues. 
[size=4][b][color=#dbb0a7]Cocoa[/color], [color=#a4c2f4]Periwinkle[/color], [color=#f4cccc]Peach[/color], [color=#ffe599]Marigold[/color],[color=#b4a7d6] [color=#d9d2e9]Violet[/color][/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Mint[/color], [color=#efefef]Cream[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4] [/size][u][b]Though you only need to search my name[/b][/u] ([size=4][b][color=#ea9999]Shardust[/color][/b][/size]) in Alternative Textures.

Some pieces have a double retexture available ( for es. the Coffee Table has a texture to match the Birch set and one for the Mahogany set)

[b][u]Other pieces have one retexture and several color combos (for es. the Birch Chair and Birch Bench have 1 texture each and 49 (forty-nine!) color variations due to using two out of the 7 color together instead of only one!)[/u][/b]

The retextured furniture pieces are:
[color=#cccccc]
[color=#ffe599]Bamboo Mat, Birch Bench, Birch Chair, Birch End Table, Birch Table, Birch Tea-Table, Blue Armchair, Blue Couch, Blue Stool, Calendar, Ceramic Pillar, China Cabinet, Coffee Table, "Dancing Grass', Dark Bookcase, Dark Rug, Decorative Lantern, Elegant Fireplace, Festive Dining Table, Globe, Gold Pillar, Green Plus Seat, Green Stool, Groovy Chair, Hanging Shield, Industrial Pipe, Iridium Fireplace, 'Kitemaster '95', Luxury Bookcase, Mahogany Bench, Mahogany Chair, Mahogany Dining Table, Mahogany End Table, Mahogany Table, Mahogany Tea-Table, Metal Chair, Modern Bench, Modern Bookcase, Modern End Table, Modern Table, Modern Tea-Table, Monster Rug, Needlepoint Flower, Oak Bench, Oak Chair, Orange Office Stool, Ornate Window, Pink Office Chair, Pink Plus Seat, 'Primal Motion', Red Armchair, Red Couch, S. Pine, Small Plant, Snowy Rug, Stone Slab, 'The Muzzamaroo', 'VGA Paradise', Walnut Bench, Walnut Chair, Wallpapers and Floors.[/color][/color]

More furniture retextures wil be added in the future (still need to to the beds for examples), though I plan to alternate between original Textures, Hairstyles, and Recolors so an update to this won't come too soon.

[u][b]Thanks for checking out my mods![/b][/u]

[i](If you enjoyed my mods and wish to fuel my pizza cravings (I'm Italian, I [b][u]always[/u][/b] want pizza) with a tip, [url=https://ko-fi.com/ladyshardust]I have a Ko-Fi[/url]﻿, though rest assured all my mods will forever be freely available)
[/i]
